cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you give me your first two turns, even if it costs you the match?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can choose which pieces I move. You said you were on my side.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just the opening turn, then. Pick my piece and let me take your move.

reason: A gives B piece control and reduces two ceded turns to one, retaining a genuine disadvantage as evidence of loyalty instead of an emotion metaphor.
